grain: one collections case at the supplied 2026-09-28 snapshot
implementation: sql/features.sql plus text_signals.py rules-v0.4; approved transcript provenance comes from curated.transcripts
serving: offline export and online case lookup both read features.case_current; there is no second live formula
history: Historical training snapshots are unsupported because current-only case and identity facts are not point-in-time histories.
window_convention: Inclusive calendar dates ending on the snapshot day: 7 days begins 6 days earlier, 90 days begins 89 days earlier. This is not an intraday rolling contact authorisation calculation.

features.case_max_dpd: Maximum of current case DPD and linked account DPD; missing account coverage is exposed separately.
features.case_overdue_cad: Validated case-level total_overdue_cad; never sum it after joining child records.
features.days_since_payment: Calendar days since latest known payment on a linked account; null if unknown.
features.broken_ptp_90d: Recorded broken promises with observed status timestamp and due date within the defined current window; final statuses never reconstruct historical features.
features.kept_ptp_rate_90d: Kept / (kept + partially_kept + broken) for promises due in the last 90 calendar dates with observed outcome by cutoff; null if denominator is zero.
features.open_ptp_days_to_due: Days to the earliest future-or-today open promise; null if absent. Overdue open promises need separate review.
features.salary_decline_ratio: 1 - latest complete month's linked-account salary / mean of the preceding three complete months; null without all four monthly observations or with zero baseline; negative values indicate growth.
features.contact_attempts_7d: Outbound non-system contacts in the seven snapshot calendar dates. Separate call count drives the provisional call-cap guard.
features.channel_rpc_rate_90d: Per-channel mean of observed RPC booleans for outbound non-system contacts in 90 snapshot calendar dates; empty map when absent.
features.hardship_mention: Rules-based hardship mention in notes/customer transcript turns in the last 90 dates; null without text evidence, false with evidence but no detected mention. Safeguard only, not repayment ranking.
features.callback_request: Rules-based callback signal in the same text window; null without evidence. It does not authorise contact.
features.action_eligibility: Provisional hold/review state. Every proposed contact also needs the live policy gate. Unknown safeguard and consent fields fail closed. No action executes automatically.

source_evidence: IDs and per-source boolean signals are retained in text_sources; raw note text, customer names and protected fields are excluded.
limitations: Rules-based NLP is a development baseline and needs human review; public-label metrics are not held-out results.
Snapshot calendar-window counts cannot authorise a real-time rolling-window contact.
Missing source coverage is not evidence of no activity or no hardship.
Contact policy checks are for the synthetic release; production requires current facts, a provincial holiday calendar and authentication.
source_approval: Contacts, promises and notes exclude resolved account/customer ownership contradictions. Transcript sources require approved case/customer identity and exclude resolved contradictory or quarantined contact links. Unresolved contact linkage remains explicitly unknown in curated.transcripts.
